company.name: Tigris Data
company.shortDescription: Tigris is an S3-compatible, globally distributed object storage service that is purpose-built for AI.
company.description: Like the Unix philosophy, we do one thing and do it right: storage, built for AI. Tigris is an S3-compatible, globally distributed object storage service that unlocks true choice for builders. Use all the familiar tools you love, mix and match any compute provider, and stay free from Big Cloud lock-in.

productsAndServices.description: A multi-region object storage service compatible with AWS S3 API, providing global data availability and zero egress fees.
productsAndServices.name: Tigris Globally Distributed S3-Compatible Object Storage

productsAndServices.description: A migration feature that enables incremental, on-demand data copying from existing cloud storage to Tigris with read-through and write-through capabilities.
productsAndServices.name: Shadow Bucket Migration

productsAndServices.description: A caching service that stores Docker images pulled from Docker Hub in Tigris to reduce rate limit impacts and improve image pull performance.
productsAndServices.name: Docker Hub Pull-Through Cache

productsAndServices.description: A feature that fetches and caches files from another S3-compatible source on demand, enabling global thumbnail generation and delivery with caching.
productsAndServices.name: Shadow Buckets for Global Image Delivery and Thumbnailing

productsAndServices.description: Support for backing up and restoring FoundationDB databases using Tigris as the object storage backend for continuous and logical backups.
productsAndServices.name: FoundationDB Backup and Disaster Recovery Integration

aiResearchSummary.text: Tigris Data is focused on developing methods for efficient storage and retrieval of small objects in distributed systems. Their research involves a computer-implemented method that optimizes the storage process by inlining objects in metadata storage and coalescing them for storage in an object store. This approach enhances the efficiency of object storage systems, aligning with Tigris's focus on globally distributed, S3-compatible object storage solutions.
